_about: Brands listed on evomobil.rs. Collected from each brand's official Serbian website on 2026-10-15. Prices are 'from' prices as shown on the site that day, in EUR. null = not found on the site; check manually. logo_url is the file the brand uses in its own site header; ask the importer for official logo files and permission before publishing. Where a site did not state body type or powertrain, a few well-known values were filled in (e.g. Tiggo = SUV, Arrizo 8 = sedan, JAC T9 = pikap); verify before publishing. Logo files are in the logos folder (provided by the site owner on 2026-10-15); on the homepage they are shown in one color that follows the light or dark theme. range_wltp_km = WLTP range of the longest-range version, from manufacturer or press sources (checked 2026-10-15). Fact-checked against importer sites on 2026-10-16. Only passenger models (cars, SUVs, pickups) are shown on the site; vans, trucks and buses are kept here but not listed.
